motion.camera: steady push from 0.96 to the CSS-authored 1.0 hero state over 6.2 seconds, then a motionless final hold

motion.pattern_interrupt: at 4.8s one fire-red diagonal slash reverses the established left-to-right motion before the final lockup
motion.finale: a 14-chip deterministic fire-colored burst fires when 変えろ lands; motion settles by 6.35s and holds through 8s

scenes.motion: the battlefield pushes forward while player and enemy cut in from opposing depths
word groups assemble along an antique-gold rule and lock into a tactical phrase
the final phrase slams into its hero frame, one fire-red accent pulses, then everything holds

shot_brief: A serene ruined sky is abruptly claimed by the two combatants: the small wooden player advances from the left while the fire-eater looms in from the right. A gold tactical line slices the frame, and three short Japanese phrases assemble in escalating weight until the final command locks the battlefield into a poster-like confrontation. The dominant idea is opposition becoming language: every move converges on the sentence that changes the battle.
